verses.original: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτοῦ δώδεκα τοὺς μαθητὰς ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν ἀκαθάρτων πνευμάτων ὥστε ἐκβάλλειν αὐτὰ καὶ θεραπεύειν πᾶσαν νόσον καὶ πᾶσαν μαλακίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai proskalesamenos autou dōdeka tous mathētas edōken autois exousian akathartōn pneumatōn hōste ekballein auta kai therapeuein pasan noson kai pasan malakian
verses.literal: And calling His twelve - disciples {to Him} [Jesus] gave them authority over unclean spirits so that they could drive them out . . . and heal every disease and - sickness

verses.original: δὲ ταῦτα ἐστιν τὰ ὀνόματά Τῶν δώδεκα ἀποστόλων πρῶτος Σίμων ὁ λεγόμενος Πέτρος καὶ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἀδελφὸς Ἀνδρέας καὶ Ἰάκωβος ὁ τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ αὐτοῦ ὁ ἀδελφὸς Ἰωάννης
verses.transliteration: de tauta estin ta onomata Tōn dōdeka apostolōn prōtos Simōn ho legomenos Petros kai autou ho adelphos Andreas kai Iakōbos ho tou Zebedaiou kai autou ho adelphos Iōannēs
verses.literal: - These are the names of the twelve apostles first Simon - called Peter and his - brother Andrew - James [son] of Zebedee and his - brother John

verses.original: Φίλιππος καὶ Βαρθολομαῖος Θωμᾶς καὶ Μαθθαῖος ὁ τελώνης Ἰάκωβος ὁ τοῦ Ἁλφαίου καὶ Θαδδαῖος
verses.transliteration: Philippos kai Bartholomaios Thōmas kai Maththaios ho telōnēs Iakōbos ho tou Halphaiou kai Thaddaios
verses.literal: Philip and Bartholomew Thomas and Matthew the tax collector James [son] - of Alphaeus and Thaddaeus

verses.original: Σίμων ὁ Καναναῖος καὶ Ἰούδας ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης ὁ καὶ παραδοὺς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Simōn ho Kananaios kai Ioudas ho Iskariōtēs ho kai paradous auton
verses.literal: Simon the Zealot and Judas - Iscariot [who] - betrayed [Jesus]

verses.original: Τούτους τοὺς δώδεκα ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοῖς λέγων παραγγείλας μὴ ἀπέλθητε Εἰς ὁδὸν ἐθνῶν καὶ μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς πόλιν Σαμαριτῶν
verses.transliteration: Toutous tous dōdeka ho Iēsous apesteilen autois legōn parangeilas mē apelthēte Eis hodon ethnōn kai mē eiselthēte eis polin Samaritōn
verses.literal: These - twelve - Jesus sent out - with [the following] instructions Do not go onto the road of the Gentiles [or] enter . . . . . . any town of [the] Samaritans

verses.original: πορεύεσθε δὲ μᾶλλον πρὸς τὰ τὰ ἀπολωλότα πρόβατα οἴκου Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: poreuesthe de mallon pros ta ta apolōlota probata oikou Israēl
verses.literal: Go - rather to the - lost sheep - of Israel

verses.original: δὲ πορευόμενοι κηρύσσετε λέγοντες ὅτι ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν Ἤγγικεν
verses.transliteration: de poreuomenoi kēryssete legontes hoti hē basileia tōn ouranōn Ēngiken
verses.literal: As you go preach this message - The kingdom of heaven is near

verses.original: θεραπεύετε ἀσθενοῦντας ἐγείρετε νεκροὺς καθαρίζετε λεπροὺς ἐκβάλλετε δαιμόνια δωρεὰν ἐλάβετε δωρεὰν δότε
verses.transliteration: therapeuete asthenountas egeirete nekrous katharizete leprous ekballete daimonia dōrean elabete dōrean dote
verses.literal: Heal the sick raise [the] dead cleanse [the] lepers drive out demons Freely you have received freely give

verses.original: Μὴ κτήσησθε χρυσὸν μηδὲ ἄργυρον μηδὲ χαλκὸν εἰς ὑμῶν τὰς ζώνας
verses.transliteration: Mē ktēsēsthe chryson mēde argyron mēde chalkon eis hymōn tas zōnas
verses.literal: {Do} not take along [any] gold or silver or copper in your - belts

verses.original: μὴ πήραν εἰς ὁδὸν μηδὲ δύο χιτῶνας μηδὲ ὑποδήματα μηδὲ ῥάβδον γὰρ ὁ ἐργάτης ἄξιος τῆς αὐτοῦ τροφῆς
verses.transliteration: mē pēran eis hodon mēde dyo chitōnas mēde hypodēmata mēde rhabdon gar ho ergatēs axios tēs autou trophēs
verses.literal: [Take] no bag for [the] road or second tunic or sandals or staff for the worker [is] worthy of his provisions

verses.original: δ’ Εἰς ἣν ἂν πόλιν ἢ κώμην εἰσέλθητε ἐξετάσατε τίς ἐστιν ἄξιός ἐν αὐτῇ μείνατε κἀκεῖ ἕως ἂν ἐξέλθητε
verses.transliteration: d’ Eis hēn an polin ē kōmēn eiselthēte exetasate tis estin axios en autē meinate kakei heōs an exelthēte
verses.literal: - - Whatever . . . town or village you enter find out who is worthy there . . . [and] stay [at his house] until . . . you move on

verses.original: δὲ εἰσερχόμενοι εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν ἀσπάσασθε αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: de eiserchomenoi eis tēn oikian aspasasthe autēn
verses.literal: As you enter . . . the home greet its [occupants]

verses.original: καὶ μὲν ἐὰν ἡ οἰκία ᾖ ἀξία ὑμῶν ἡ εἰρήνη ἐλθάτω ἐπ’ αὐτήν δὲ ἐὰν ᾖ μὴ ἀξία ὑμῶν ἡ εἰρήνη ἐπιστραφήτω πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: kai men ean hē oikia ē axia hymōn hē eirēnē elthatō ep’ autēn de ean ē mē axia hymōn hē eirēnē epistraphētō pros hymas
verses.literal: - - If the home is worthy {let} your - peace rest on it but if it is not - {let} your - peace return to you

verses.original: καὶ ὃς ἂν μὴ δέξηται ὑμᾶς μηδὲ ἀκούσῃ ὑμῶν τοὺς λόγους ἐκτινάξατε τὸν κονιορτὸν τῶν ὑμῶν ποδῶν ἐξερχόμενοι ἔξω ἐκείνης τῆς οἰκίας ἢ τῆς πόλεως
verses.transliteration: kai hos an mē dexētai hymas mēde akousē hymōn tous logous ektinaxate ton koniorton tōn hymōn podōn exerchomenoi exō ekeinēs tēs oikias ē tēs poleōs
verses.literal: And if anyone . . . vvv will not welcome you or heed your - words shake the dust off your feet when you leave . . . that - home or - town

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἔσται ἀνεκτότερον γῇ Σοδόμων καὶ Γομόρρων ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως ἢ ἐκείνῃ τῇ πόλει
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin estai anektoteron gē Sodomōn kai Gomorrōn en hēmera kriseōs ē ekeinē tē polei
verses.literal: Truly I tell you it will be more bearable - for Sodom and Gomorrah on [the] day of judgment than for that - town

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω ὑμᾶς ὡς πρόβατα ἐν μέσῳ λύκων οὖν γίνεσθε φρόνιμοι ὡς οἱ ὄφεις καὶ ἀκέραιοι ὡς αἱ περιστεραί
verses.transliteration: Idou egō apostellō hymas hōs probata en mesō lykōn oun ginesthe phronimoi hōs hoi opheis kai akeraioi hōs hai peristerai
verses.literal: Behold I am sending you out . . . like sheep among . . . wolves therefore be as shrewd as - snakes and as innocent as - doves

verses.original: δὲ Προσέχετε ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων γὰρ παραδώσουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς συνέδρια καὶ μαστιγώσουσιν ὑμᾶς ἐν αὐτῶν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς
verses.transliteration: de Prosechete apo tōn anthrōpōn gar paradōsousin hymas eis synedria kai mastigōsousin hymas en autōn tais synagōgais
verses.literal: But beware of - men for they will hand you over . . . to [their] councils and flog you in their - synagogues

verses.original: καὶ ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ ἀχθήσεσθε δὲ ἐπὶ ἡγεμόνας καὶ βασιλεῖς εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς καὶ τοῖς ἔθνεσιν
verses.transliteration: kai heneken emou achthēsesthe de epi hēgemonas kai basileis eis martyrion autois kai tois ethnesin
verses.literal: - On My account . . . you will be brought - before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the Gentiles

verses.original: δὲ ὅταν παραδῶσιν ὑμᾶς μὴ μεριμνήσητε πῶς ἢ τί λαλήσητε γὰρ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ ὑμῖν δοθήσεται τί λαλήσητε
verses.transliteration: de hotan paradōsin hymas mē merimnēsēte pōs ē ti lalēsēte gar en ekeinē tē hōra hymin dothēsetai ti lalēsēte
verses.literal: But when they hand you over . . . [do] not worry about how [to respond] or what to say - In that - hour you will be given what to say

verses.original: γὰρ ἐστε οὐ ὑμεῖς οἱ λαλοῦντες ἀλλὰ τὸ Πνεῦμα τοῦ ὑμῶν Πατρὸς τὸ λαλοῦν ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: gar este ou hymeis hoi lalountes alla to Pneuma tou hymōn Patros to laloun en hymin
verses.literal: For it will not be . . . you - speaking but the Spirit of your Father - speaking through you

verses.original: δὲ ἀδελφὸς Παραδώσει ἀδελφὸν εἰς θάνατον καὶ πατὴρ τέκνον καὶ τέκνα ἐπαναστήσονται ἐπὶ γονεῖς καὶ θανατώσουσιν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: de adelphos Paradōsei adelphon eis thanaton kai patēr teknon kai tekna epanastēsontai epi goneis kai thanatōsousin autous
verses.literal: - Brother will betray brother to death and a father [his] child - children will rise against [their] parents and have them put to death . . .

verses.original: καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων διὰ μου τὸ ὄνομά δὲ ὁ ὑπομείνας εἰς τέλος οὗτος σωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: kai esesthe misoumenoi hypo pantōn dia mou to onoma de ho hypomeinas eis telos houtos sōthēsetai
verses.literal: - You will be hated by everyone because of My - name but the [one who] perseveres to [the] end - will be saved

verses.original: δὲ Ὅταν διώκωσιν ὑμᾶς ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ πόλει φεύγετε εἰς τὴν ἑτέραν γὰρ ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν τελέσητε οὐ μὴ τὰς πόλεις τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ἕως ἂν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἔλθῃ
verses.transliteration: de Hotan diōkōsin hymas en tautē tē polei pheugete eis tēn heteran gar amēn legō hymin telesēte ou mē tas poleis tou Israēl heōs an ho Huios tou anthrōpou elthē
verses.literal: - When they persecute you in one - town flee to the next - Truly I tell you you will not reach . . . . . . [all] the towns of Israel before . . . the Son of Man comes

verses.original: μαθητὴς ἔστιν Οὐκ ὑπὲρ τὸν διδάσκαλον οὐδὲ δοῦλος ὑπὲρ αὐτοῦ τὸν κύριον
verses.transliteration: mathētēs estin Ouk hyper ton didaskalon oude doulos hyper autou ton kyrion
verses.literal: A disciple is not above [his] teacher nor a servant above his - master

verses.original: ἀρκετὸν τῷ μαθητῇ ἵνα γένηται ὡς αὐτοῦ ὁ διδάσκαλος καὶ ὁ δοῦλος ὡς αὐτοῦ ὁ κύριος εἰ τὸν οἰκοδεσπότην ἐπεκάλεσαν Βεελζεβοὺλ πόσῳ μᾶλλον τοὺς αὐτοῦ οἰκιακοὺς
verses.transliteration: arketon tō mathētē hina genētai hōs autou ho didaskalos kai ho doulos hōs autou ho kyrios ei ton oikodespotēn epekalesan Beelzeboul posō mallon tous autou oikiakous
verses.literal: [It is] enough for a disciple to be like his - teacher and a servant like his - master If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul how much more the members of his household

verses.original: οὖν φοβηθῆτε Μὴ αὐτούς γάρ ἐστιν οὐδὲν κεκαλυμμένον ὃ οὐκ ἀποκαλυφθήσεται καὶ κρυπτὸν ὃ γνωσθήσεται οὐ
verses.transliteration: oun phobēthēte Mē autous gar estin ouden kekalymmenon ho ouk apokalyphthēsetai kai krypton ho gnōsthēsetai ou
verses.literal: So do not be afraid . . . of them For there is nothing concealed that vvv will not be disclosed and [nothing] hidden that will not be made known . . .

verses.original: ὃ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ εἴπατε ἐν τῷ φωτί καὶ ὃ ἀκούετε εἰς τὸ οὖς κηρύξατε ἐπὶ τῶν δωμάτων
verses.transliteration: ho legō hymin en tē skotia eipate en tō phōti kai ho akouete eis to ous kēryxate epi tōn dōmatōn
verses.literal: What I tell you in the dark speak in the daylight - what is whispered in [your] ear proclaim from the housetops

verses.original: Καὶ φοβεῖσθε μὴ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀποκτεννόντων τὸ σῶμα δὲ δυναμένων μὴ ἀποκτεῖναι τὴν ψυχὴν δὲ μᾶλλον φοβεῖσθε τὸν δυνάμενον ἀπολέσαι καὶ ψυχὴν καὶ σῶμα ἐν γεέννῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai phobeisthe mē apo tōn apoktennontōn to sōma de dynamenōn mē apokteinai tēn psychēn de mallon phobeisthe ton dynamenon apolesai kai psychēn kai sōma en geennē
verses.literal: - Do not be afraid . . . of those who kill the body but cannot . . . kill the soul vvv Instead fear the [One who] can destroy both soul and body in hell

verses.original: Οὐχὶ δύο στρουθία πωλεῖται ἀσσαρίου καὶ οὐ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν πεσεῖται ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἄνευ ὑμῶν τοῦ Πατρὸς
verses.transliteration: Ouchi dyo strouthia pōleitai assariou kai ou hen ex autōn peseitai epi tēn gēn aneu hymōn tou Patros
verses.literal: {Are} not two sparrows sold for a penny Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your - Father

verses.original: δὲ καὶ αἱ τρίχες τῆς ὑμῶν κεφαλῆς εἰσίν πᾶσαι ἠριθμημέναι
verses.transliteration: de kai hai triches tēs hymōn kephalēs eisin pasai ērithmēmenai
verses.literal: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered

verses.original: οὖν φοβεῖσθε μὴ ὑμεῖς διαφέρετε πολλῶν στρουθίων
verses.transliteration: oun phobeisthe mē hymeis diapherete pollōn strouthiōn
verses.literal: So do not be afraid . . . you are worth more than many sparrows

verses.original: οὖν Πᾶς ὅστις ὁμολογήσει ἐν ἐμοὶ ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων κἀγὼ ὁμολογήσω ἐν αὐτῷ ἔμπροσθεν μου τοῦ Πατρός τοῦ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς
verses.transliteration: oun Pas hostis homologēsei en emoi emprosthen tōn anthrōpōn kagō homologēsō en autō emprosthen mou tou Patros tou en tois ouranois
verses.literal: Therefore everyone who confesses . . . Me before - men vvv I will also confess . . . him before My - Father - in - heaven

verses.original: δ’ ὅστις ἂν ἀρνήσηταί με ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων κἀγὼ ἀρνήσομαι αὐτὸν ἔμπροσθεν μου τοῦ Πατρός τοῦ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς
verses.transliteration: d’ hostis an arnēsētai me emprosthen tōn anthrōpōn kagō arnēsomai auton emprosthen mou tou Patros tou en tois ouranois
verses.literal: But whoever . . . denies Me before - men vvv I will also deny him before My - Father - in - heaven

verses.original: Μὴ νομίσητε ὅτι ἦλθον βαλεῖν εἰρήνην ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἦλθον οὐκ βαλεῖν εἰρήνην ἀλλὰ μάχαιραν
verses.transliteration: Mē nomisēte hoti ēlthon balein eirēnēn epi tēn gēn ēlthon ouk balein eirēnēn alla machairan
verses.literal: {Do} not assume that I have come to bring peace to the earth I have not come . . . to bring peace but a sword

verses.original: γὰρ ἦλθον διχάσαι Ἄνθρωπον κατὰ αὐτοῦ τοῦ πατρὸς Καὶ θυγατέρα κατὰ αὐτῆς τῆς μητρὸς Καὶ νύμφην κατὰ αὐτῆς τῆς πενθερᾶς
verses.transliteration: gar ēlthon dichasai Anthrōpon kata autou tou patros Kai thygatera kata autēs tēs mētros Kai nymphēn kata autēs tēs pentheras
verses.literal: For I have come to turn a man against his - father - a daughter against her - mother - a daughter-in-law against her - mother-in-law

verses.original: Καὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐχθροὶ οἱ αὐτοῦ οἰκιακοὶ
verses.transliteration: Kai tou anthrōpou echthroi hoi autou oikiakoi
verses.literal: - vvv A man’s enemies [will be] the [members] of his own household

verses.original: Ὁ φιλῶν πατέρα ἢ μητέρα ὑπὲρ ἐμὲ ἔστιν οὐκ ἄξιος μου καὶ ὁ φιλῶν υἱὸν ἢ θυγατέρα ὑπὲρ ἐμὲ ἔστιν οὐκ ἄξιος μου
verses.transliteration: Ho philōn patera ē mētera hyper eme estin ouk axios mou kai ho philōn huion ē thygatera hyper eme estin ouk axios mou
verses.literal: Anyone who loves [his] father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me - anyone who loves [his] son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me

verses.original: καὶ ὃς λαμβάνει οὐ αὐτοῦ τὸν σταυρὸν καὶ ἀκολουθεῖ ὀπίσω μου ἔστιν οὐκ ἄξιος μου
verses.transliteration: kai hos lambanei ou autou ton stauron kai akolouthei opisō mou estin ouk axios mou
verses.literal: and anyone who does not take up . . . his - cross and follow - Me is not worthy of Me

verses.original: ὁ εὑρὼν αὐτοῦ τὴν ψυχὴν ἀπολέσει αὐτήν καὶ ὁ ἀπολέσας αὐτοῦ τὴν ψυχὴν ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ εὑρήσει αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: ho heurōn autou tēn psychēn apolesei autēn kai ho apolesas autou tēn psychēn heneken emou heurēsei autēn
verses.literal: Whoever finds his - life will lose it and whoever loses his - life for My sake . . . will find it

verses.original: Ὁ δεχόμενος ὑμᾶς δέχεται ἐμὲ καὶ ὁ δεχόμενος ἐμὲ δέχεται τὸν ἀποστείλαντά με
verses.transliteration: Ho dechomenos hymas dechetai eme kai ho dechomenos eme dechetai ton aposteilanta me
verses.literal: He who receives you receives Me and he who receives Me receives the [One who] sent Me

verses.original: ὁ δεχόμενος προφήτην εἰς ὄνομα προφήτου λήμψεται προφήτου μισθὸν καὶ ὁ δεχόμενος δίκαιον εἰς ὄνομα δικαίου λήμψεται δικαίου μισθὸν
verses.transliteration: ho dechomenos prophētēn eis onoma prophētou lēmpsetai prophētou misthon kai ho dechomenos dikaion eis onoma dikaiou lēmpsetai dikaiou misthon
verses.literal: Whoever receives a prophet because he is . . . a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward and whoever receives a righteous [man] because he is . . . a righteous [man] will receive a righteous [man’s] reward

verses.original: καὶ ὃς ἂν ποτίσῃ μόνον ποτήριον ψυχροῦ ἕνα τούτων τῶν μικρῶν εἰς ὄνομα μαθητοῦ ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἀπολέσῃ οὐ μὴ αὐτοῦ τὸν μισθὸν
verses.transliteration: kai hos an potisē monon potērion psychrou hena toutōn tōn mikrōn eis onoma mathētou amēn legō hymin apolesē ou mē autou ton misthon
verses.literal: And if anyone . . . gives even a cup of cold [water] to one of these - little ones - [because he is My] disciple truly I tell you he will never lose . . . . . . his - reward
